summary: Migration examples for hashicorp.vault.kv2_secret: vault_kv2_write becomes kv2_secret with the same url, path and data; vault_kv2_delete becomes kv2_secret with state: absent, optionally with versions: [1, 3]. KV2 deletes are soft deletes.
questions: How do I write a KV2 secret with hashicorp.vault?
How do I delete specific versions of a KV2 secret?

answer_card.title: kv2 write and delete with hashicorp.vault
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Write/create a secret
  hashicorp.vault.kv2_secret:
    url: https://vault:8200
    path: hello
    data:
      foo: bar

- name: Delete versions 1 and 3
  hashicorp.vault.kv2_secret:
    url: https://vault:8201
    path: secret/mysecret
    versions: [1, 3]
    state: absent
```
Omit `versions` to delete the latest version. KV2 deletes are soft deletes.
